summary: PASS with one Low observation. D-040 closes F-DG0-166/249: a CLOSED_VERIFIED fix must now be an ancestor of the verifying run's real head_commit_at_start and of the gate candidate, and my round-23 forge is rejected. The comments now describe the strict model (F-DG0-014/167). All 110 real closures satisfy the new binding, and the F-DG0-164/165/246 protections still hold. New F-DG0-168 (Low, non-mandatory): D-040 replaced the round-candidate ancestry check instead of adding to it, so in a genuine round a fix committed between the freeze and the verifier's run start now closes a finding (round 23 rejected this). The fix must still be in the reviewed gate candidate, so the effect is limited to mis-attribution. All tests, the pre-freeze, determinism, secrets and sandbox probes pass.
